officialSources.observation: Israel Mapping Center publishes a parcel SHP dataset with a note that it is not legal authority for boundary reconstruction and freshness must be checked by users.
Survey of Israel offers information for unregistered cadastral areas in Jerusalem via an application, indicating coverage can be incomplete.
This guessed CKAN dataset URL returned HTTP 404. It is not evidence that the Israel Mapping Center has no open parcel data.

Official Govmap Open Data GeoServer WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200. It advertises `opendata:PARCEL_ALL` (Hebrew title “חלקות”, parcels), `opendata:SUB_GUSH_ALL` (blocks), and ITM-coordinate variants.

DescribeFeatureType returned HTTP 200; geometry field is `the_geom` (MultiSurface); safe parcel fields are OBJECTID, PARCEL_ID, GUSH_NUM, GUSH_SUFFI, and PARCEL. No personal/owner attributes were requested in the successful sample query.
The official Govmap viewer hostname returned HTTP 403 CloudFront challenge in direct probes, while its documented Open Data WFS endpoint remained accessible and returned the verified parcel geometry.

Jerusalem Municipality open-data dataset titled חלקות (plots) identifies the dataset as municipal parcel information and links its source to the city GIS viewer; opened and inspected. The published CSV/XLSX downloads are dated February 2021.
Israeli government Hebrew service page for cadastral information in unregistered areas of Jerusalem; the page was returned in official search results, while direct opening returned HTTP 403.

registryBasis: Official Israel Mapping Center/Govmap public parcel layer provides national cadastral polygons. The layer is not a legal title record; city-area geometry is verified independently.

sourceCandidate.kind: OGC WFS 2.0.0 GeoServer parcel feature type
sourceCandidate.publisher: Israel Mapping Center / Govmap Open Data
sourceCandidate.scope: National parcel layer; bounded adapter qualification verifies city-area rows only. The national layer does not determine Jerusalem/East Jerusalem boundaries, sovereignty, or legal title.
sourceCandidate.sampleAttributes: OBJECTID, PARCEL_ID, GUSH_NUM, GUSH_SUFFI, PARCEL only
sourceCandidate.stableSourceRowIdSemantics: Unique provider row identifier for exact runtime reads; not represented as a statutory/legal parcel-number key.
sourceCandidate.parcelIdUniqueness: PARCEL_ID is not unique in this layer; OBJECTID is the canonical adapter row identity.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National parcel layer according to public WFS capabilities.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: 123 complete source parcel rows in 13 separate city cells; fresh shared-identity and footprint/binding checks pass. Provider OBJECTID references are not statutory parcel numbers. Wider completeness and legal currentness unverified. Geographic city scope does not express a political boundary or recognition claim. Large exact-ID batches can be slow (40 rows took 85 seconds); original transient timeouts are retained in evidence.
coverageAssessment.territorialCaveat: Govmap parcel coverage in a city-area sample does not determine Jerusalem/East Jerusalem boundaries, sovereignty, or legal title.

remainingUncertainty: The bounded runtime qualification verifies only the sampled cells and rows; it does not establish citywide completeness, legal title, currentness, or political boundaries.
